Got fired today because I asked for a pay raise last week…. Which they initially gave me. I have been at my company for 4 1/2 years and felt very close to my boss, always had what I thought (and he said) was open and honest communication. So when I went to him (after telling him for weeks) about why I needed a two dollar raise, and that he agreed with me, and offered me more hours the next month. I didn’t think he would come back 5 days later and fire me over it. Apparently I came off “aggressive” when I told him that I needed the a two dollar raise to afford rent, and that I was “cornered him” with a meeting that he knew what about and weeks in advance. That I was clearly “disloyal” to him because I said “this isn’t me threatening to quit, this is just me telling you that if I don’t get this raise from here, I’m going to have to get a second job to pay for my bills” so because I would ever look out for myself financially, he, after agreeing to give me the raise starting next week, with no communication that he was uncomfortable with what happened, after negotiating with me about the increase in hours next month, with no word said about it over the next two days for the weekend, he asked me at 9:30 at night to come in my off time the next day to fire me. He had a whole speech prepared, typed out with him, gave the whole 25 minute thing were I sat quietly, and he ended it with him saying that I will get two weeks of severance. He then asked if I wanted to talk about this. Essentially asking me to beg for my job. I ended up saying “let us end this on a good note, clearly trust here has been broken both ways.” He turned pale and started going on how he didn’t want us on a bad note, and I said we are not, we just don’t have a business relationship anymore. I will wait for my severance” Now mind you this whole time he kept saying that he had absolutely only had good things to say about me. Multiple times throughout the whole thing. Kept telling me that “HE would be just fine without me “like he was guilt tripping me? I honestly don’t know but didn’t work. And honestly he just made it extremely weird. I honestly hated working for him, it was a small business that he brought his personal life into and that I know to much about, and honestly have no respect for him. The pay was only okay and I honestly stayed with it to be near my family. Do I want a new job ASAP? Yes, manly because the job market ends up with you unemployed for an average of 6 months at LEAST. As I worried no, and I am 1000% percent better off for it, and honestly will not miss it.
